info.title: gpk
info.description: gpk, the GamePatchKit command line tool: package, diff, verify, compact, plan-download and sign game data releases

commands.name: compact
commands.description: Rebuild selected bundle groups as a new baseline

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Report logical file and physical artifact differences between two releases

commands.name: package
commands.description: Create the first or an incremental release

commands.name: plan-download
commands.description: Compute what a local state needs to reach a target release

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify a published release: schema, references, artifact bytes, signature document

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit a machine-readable result on stdout

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Compute and report without creating any file (package, compact, sign)
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 input error, 2 integrity error, 3 execution failure
